// This file is not part of the operator build. TestTSDProxyCompat copies it
// into tsdproxy's internal/targetproviders/list package, in a temporary copy
// of tsdproxy's source, so that the operator's rendered proxies.yaml is parsed
// by tsdproxy's own list provider and the resulting proxy configuration is
// compared with what the Proxy resources asked for.

package list

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/rs/zerolog"

	"github.com/almeidapaulopt/tsdproxy/internal/config"
	"github.com/almeidapaulopt/tsdproxy/internal/model"
)

type compatPort struct {
	Protocol    string `json:"protocol"`
	Port        int    `json:"port"`
	Target      string `json:"target"`
	TLSValidate bool   `json:"tlsValidate"`
	IsRedirect  bool   `json:"isRedirect"`
	Funnel      bool   `json:"funnel"`
}

type compatProxy struct {
	Ports        map[string]compatPort `json:"ports"`
	Tags         string                `json:"tags"`
	Icon         string                `json:"icon"`
	Label        string                `json:"label"`
	Category     string                `json:"category"`
	Ephemeral    bool                  `json:"ephemeral"`
	RunWebClient bool                  `json:"runWebClient"`
	Verbose      bool                  `json:"verbose"`
}

func TestOperatorCompat(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("OPERATOR_COMPAT_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("OPERATOR_COMPAT_DIR not set")
	}

	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "expect.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read expectations: %v", err)
	}
	var expect map[string]compatProxy
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &expect); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse expectations: %v", err)
	}

	c, err := New(zerolog.Nop(), "kubernetes", &config.ListTargetProviderConfig{
		Filename:             filepath.Join(dir, "proxies.yaml"),
		DefaultProxyProvider: "default",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("list provider rejected proxies.yaml: %v", err)
	}
	if len(c.configProxies) != len(expect) {
		t.Fatalf("list has %d proxies, want %d", len(c.configProxies), len(expect))
	}

	for name, want := range expect {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, err := c.AddTarget(name)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("AddTarget: %v", err)
			}
			if err := model.ValidateProxyPorts(cfg); err != nil {
				t.Errorf("ValidateProxyPorts: %v", err)
			}
			if cfg.Hostname != name || cfg.ProxyProvider != "default" {
				t.Errorf("hostname=%q proxyProvider=%q", cfg.Hostname, cfg.ProxyProvider)
			}
			if cfg.Tailscale.Tags != want.Tags || cfg.Tailscale.Ephemeral != want.Ephemeral ||
				cfg.Tailscale.RunWebClient != want.RunWebClient || cfg.Tailscale.Verbose != want.Verbose {
				t.Errorf("tailscale = %+v, want %+v", cfg.Tailscale, want)
			}
			if cfg.Tailscale.AuthKey.Value() != "" {
				t.Error("list entry carries an auth key")
			}
			if !cfg.Dashboard.Visible {
				t.Error("proxy is hidden from the dashboard and REST API")
			}
			if cfg.Dashboard.Icon != want.Icon || cfg.Dashboard.Label != want.Label ||
				cfg.Dashboard.Category != want.Category {
				t.Errorf("dashboard = %+v, want icon=%q label=%q category=%q",
					cfg.Dashboard, want.Icon, want.Label, want.Category)
			}

			// A port tsdproxy fails to parse is logged and dropped, so the
			// count catches silently missing ports.
			if len(cfg.Ports) != len(want.Ports) {
				t.Fatalf("got %d ports, want %d", len(cfg.Ports), len(want.Ports))
			}
			for key, wp := range want.Ports {
				got, ok := cfg.Ports[key]
				if !ok {
					t.Errorf("port %q missing", key)
					continue
				}
				if got.ProxyProtocol != wp.Protocol || got.ProxyPort != wp.Port {
					t.Errorf("port %q parsed as %d/%s", key, got.ProxyPort, got.ProxyProtocol)
				}
				if got.GetFirstTargetString() != wp.Target {
					t.Errorf("port %q target = %q, want %q", key, got.GetFirstTargetString(), wp.Target)
				}
				if got.TLSValidate != wp.TLSValidate || got.IsRedirect != wp.IsRedirect ||
					got.Tailscale.Funnel != wp.Funnel {
					t.Errorf("port %q = tlsValidate:%v isRedirect:%v funnel:%v, want %+v",
						key, got.TLSValidate, got.IsRedirect, got.Tailscale.Funnel, wp)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
